author: webadmin
title: Where Is The Hunting Ban, Labour?
content:
This fox was illegally hunted at a joint meet of the North Cotswold Hunt and the Warwickshire Hunt on Saturday 14th November. Image credit: West Midlands Hunt Sabs




In July 2024, the Labour Government made a manifesto commitment to ban trail hunting and improve the Hunting Act.




On 26 March 2026, the Government launched a consultation to determine how best to implement an effective and enforceable ban on trail hunting in England and Wales.




The consultation closed on 18 June, having received 184,000 responses. Yet months later, we are still waiting for the results and a clear timetable for what happens next.




The Government has acknowledged the risks trail hunting poses to wildlife, including the danger of hounds pursuing and killing live animals. It has also recognised concerns that trail hunting can be used as a smokescreen for illegal hunting.
















This fox was hunted and killed by the Blackmore and Sparkford Vale (BSV) Hunt on Thursday 19th November. Image credit: Locals Against The BSV Hunt




Meanwhile, wildlife continues to suffer.




Foxes and other wild animals are chased, injured and killed. Our local hunt saboteur groups are out week after week, witnessing and documenting incidents and working to protect wildlife, often with little support.




But hunting also affects people. Rural residents face disruption, trespass, intimidation, road safety issues and damage to property. Their experiences should not be overlooked.




The Countryside Alliance and British Hound Sports Association continue to portray a ban on trail hunting as an attack on rural communities, livelihoods and countryside traditions.




But protecting wildlife and rural communities is not an attack on the countryside. Nor should legitimate countryside activities be used as a justification for allowing hunting with dogs to continue.




A ban must be comprehensive. Simply banning trail hunting is not enough if exemptions and loopholes allow hunts to continue pursuing and killing wildlife under another guise.




The HSA is calling for a full and effective ban on hunting with dogs, removing the existing exemptions and loopholes that allow this cruelty to continue, alongside meaningful improvements to the Hunting Act.




WE NEED THE GOVERNMENT TO ACT




We are demanding three things:







Publish the consultation results and the Government’s response.




Publish the legislative proposals for a full and effective ban on hunting with dogs and improvements to the Hunting Act, removing exemptions and loopholes.




Set a clear date for introducing the necessary legislation to Parliament.







We cannot allow this commitment to disappear into the political long grass.




Wildlife needs protection now, not at some unspecified point in the future.







TAKE ACTION







PLEASE TAKE ACTION TODAY




We need as many people as possible to contact their elected representatives and make it clear that this issue has not gone away.







Write to your MP







Ask your MP to contact the Government and demand answers to the three questions above. Ask them to press for a clear timetable and support a comprehensive ban on hunting with dogs, without exemptions or loopholes. Write to your MP 

here

.







Write to the Prime Minister







The Prime Minister has spoken about building a more caring society. That must include compassion and protection for our wildlife.




Ask him to ensure the Government honours its commitment to ban trail hunting and delivers the wider legislative changes needed to end hunting with dogs. Write to the Prime Minister 

here

.




Both messages can be brief. What matters is that MPs and the Prime Minister hear from as many people as possible.




Our wildlife cannot wait any longer. We need a full ban, effective legislation and an end to the loopholes that allow this cruelty to continue. 




NOW IS THE TIME TO MAKE OUR VOICES HEARD.







TAKE ACTION



















The post 

Where Is The Hunting Ban, Labour?

 appeared first on 

Hunt Saboteurs Association

.

title: Enflasyon ve konut beklentisi geriledi, dolar tahmini yükseldi
content:
Türkiye Cumhuriyet Merkez Bankası (TCMB), kasım ayına ilişkin “Hanehalkı Beklenti Anketi” sonuçlarını açıkladı. Verilere göre, hanehalkının yıllık enflasyon ve konut fiyatı artış beklentilerinde düşüş kaydedilirken, dolar beklentisinde artış gözlendi. 12 ay sonrası yıllık enflasyon beklentisi bir önceki aya kıyasla 0,51 puan azalarak yüzde 43,24 seviyesine geriledi. Konut fiyatlarındaki artış beklentisi de, bir önceki aya göre 0,26 puan gerileyerek yüzde 30,10 oldu.

Genel enflasyon ve konut fiyatı artış beklentilerindeki gerileme karşısında, önümüzdeki 12 ay boyunca akaryakıt ve temel gıda fiyatlarının artmasının beklediğini bildirdi.

ABD Dolar kuru beklentisi ise, bir önceki aya göre 1,32 TL artış göstererek 58,18 TL seviyesine yükseldi.

author: Unknown
title: İsviçre’de gazeteciler kötü çalışma koşulları ve işten çıkarmalara karşı alandaydı
content:
İsviçre’de medya sektöründe yaşanan işten çıkarmalar ve haber merkezlerinin küçültülmesine karşı gazeteciler başkent Bern’deki Federal Parlamento önünde protesto düzenledi. İsviçre’nin farklı kantonlarından gazetecilerin katıldığı eylemde, kamu ve özel medya kuruluşlarında yaşanan personel kayıplarının gazeteciliğin niteliğini ve çeşitliliğini tehdit ettiği vurgulandı.




“Gazeteciliği kurtarmak demokrasiyi savunmaktır” 

sloganıyla düzenlenen eylemde gazeteciler, medya sektöründeki krizin yalnızca çalışanların iş güvencesiyle ilgili olmadığını, toplumun doğru ve güvenilir bilgiye erişimini de doğrudan etkilediğini belirtti.




“İşini doğru yapan gazeteci rahatsız edici olmalı”




Eylemde konuşan gazeteci ve eski İsviçre Radyo ve Televizyonu (SRF) dış haberler servisi yöneticisi Susanne Brunner, gazetecilik mesleğinin doğası gereği eleştirel ve rahatsız edici olması gerektiğini söyledi. Brunner, gazetecilerin görevlerini yerine getirdiklerinde zaman zaman tepki çekmelerinin mesleğin bir parçası olduğunu belirterek, 

“Rahatsız edici olmak zorundasınız. Eleştirel olmak, gerçekleri açığa çıkarmak zorundasınız. Bazen insanları rahatsız ediyorsunuz. Ama bunları yapıyorsanız işinizi doğru yapıyorsunuz demektir”

 dedi.




Yaklaşık 40 yıllık gazetecilik kariyerinin ardından kendisinin de işten çıkarılma bildirimi aldığını aktaran Brunner, medya sektöründe yaşanan işten çıkarmaların yalnızca bireysel çalışanları değil, gazeteciliğin geleceğini de etkilediğini ifade etti.




Brunner, medya şirketlerinin yapay zekâyı ve daha az çalışanla aynı miktarda içerik üretme hedefini çözüm olarak sunmasına da tepki gösterdi. Haber merkezlerinin küçültülmesi ve gazetecilerin çalışma koşullarının ağırlaştırılmasının kabul edilemeyeceğini belirten Brunner, 

“Yapay zekâ sayesinde daha az insanla aynı miktarda ve aynı kalitede iş yapılabileceğini söylemek, tüm saygımla ifade ediyorum, bir yalandır”

 diye konuştu.




Gazeteciliğin geleceği için medya çalışanlarının, siyasetçilerin ve toplumun birlikte hareket etmesi gerektiğini söyleyen Brunner,

 “Şimdi vazgeçme zamanı değil”

 dedi.




"Daha az değil, daha fazla gazetecilik istiyoruz"




Eylemde Syndicom Başkan Yardımcısı Stefanie von Arburg, bağımsız gazeteciliğin demokratik toplum açısından taşıdığı öneme dikkat çekti. Medya özgürlüğü, bilgi edinme ve ifade özgürlüğünün demokrasinin temel unsurları olduğunu vurgulayan von Arburg, gazeteciliğin ekonomik çıkarlar doğrultusunda zayıflatılmasına tepki gösterdi.




Medya kuruluşlarında yıllardır devam eden yeniden yapılanmaların ve personel azaltmalarının haber merkezlerinin çalışma kapasitesini düşürdüğünü belirten von Arburg, gazetecilerin giderek daha az kaynakla daha fazla iş yapmak zorunda bırakıldığını ifade etti.




Sendikal hakların ve çalışanların söz hakkının görmezden gelinmesine tepki gösteren von Arburg, gazeteciliğin yalnızca şirket yönetimlerinin ekonomik hedeflerine göre şekillendirilemeyeceğini belirtti.




Konuşmada dile getirilen temel taleplerden biri de gazetecilik kapasitesinin azaltılması yerine güçlendirilmesiydi. Von Arburg’un konuşmasında öne çıkan 

“Daha az değil, daha fazla gazetecilik istiyoruz” 

talebi eylemin ortak mesajlarından biri oldu.




"Gazetecilik demokratik toplumun ortak değeri"







La Côte gazetecisi ve Impressum Eş Başkanı Caroline Gebhard, gazeteciliğin sıradan bir ticari ürün olarak değerlendirilemeyeceğini vurguladı. Gazeteciliğin demokratik toplumun işleyebilmesi için gerekli bilgi altyapısını oluşturduğunu belirten Gebhard, medya kuruluşlarındaki küçülmenin yalnızca gazetecileri değil, toplumun haber alma hakkını da etkilediğini ifade etti.




Haber merkezlerinde yaşanan personel kayıplarının haber çeşitliliğini ve yayınların niteliğini zayıflattığına dikkat çeken Gebhard, gazetecilik mesleğinin sürdürülebilmesi için deneyimli çalışanların bilgi ve birikiminden yararlanılması gerektiğini söyledi.




Genç gazetecilerin de mesleğe kazandırılmasının önemine değinen Gebhard, güvencesiz çalışma koşullarının ve düşük ücretlerin gazeteciliğin geleceği açısından ciddi bir sorun oluşturduğunu belirtti. Medya kuruluşlarının gazeteciliğin niteliğine yeniden yatırım yapması ve çalışanların mesleki gelişimini desteklemesi gerektiğini vurguladı.




"Medya çalışanları birlikte hareket etmeli"




SRF çalışanı ve İsviçre Medya Çalışanları Sendikası (SSM) Eş Başkanı Salvador Atasoy, medya sektöründe yaşanan sorunların aşılması için çalışanların ve meslek örgütlerinin ortak mücadele yürütmesi gerektiğini söyledi.




Medya kuruluşları arasındaki rekabetin gazetecilerin ortak taleplerinin önüne geçmemesi gerektiğini belirten Atasoy, bir medya kuruluşunda yaşanan küçülmenin yalnızca o kuruluşun çalışanlarını etkilemediğini, bütün gazetecilik alanını zayıflattığını ifade etti.




Gazetecilerin işlerini nitelikli biçimde yapabilmeleri için yeterli zamana, kaynağa ve çalışma güvencesine ihtiyaç duyduğunu vurgulayan Atasoy, işten çıkarmaların durdurulması ve haber merkezlerinin güçlendirilmesi gerektiğini belirtti.




Yapay zekânın gazetecilerin yerine geçirilmesinin ve teknolojik dönüşümün personel azaltmanın gerekçesi haline getirilmesinin gazetecilik açısından tehlikelerine dikkat çekilen konuşmada, medya kuruluşlarının çalışanların haklarını koruyarak dönüşüm politikaları geliştirmesi gerektiği mesajı verildi.




Atasoy, bağımsız gazeteciliğin sürdürülebilmesi için sendikaların, meslek örgütlerinin ve gazetecilerin dayanışma içinde hareket etmesinin önemini vurguladı.




Gazeteciliğe sürdürülebilir finansman çağrısı




Bern’deki eylemde gazeteciler ve meslek örgütleri, medya kuruluşlarının gazeteciliğin niteliğine yeniden yatırım yapmasını, işten çıkarmaların durdurulmasını, haber merkezlerinin güçlendirilmesini ve çalışanların haklarının korunmasını istedi.




Serbest ve kadrolu gazeteciler için daha iyi çalışma koşulları talep edilirken, medya sektörünün dijital platformlar karşısındaki konumunun güçlendirilmesi ve bu şirketlerin gazetecilik içeriklerinden elde ettiği gelir konusunda düzenleme yapılması çağrısı öne çıktı.




Siyasetçilere de bağımsız gazeteciliği uzun vadede güvence altına alacak sürdürülebilir finansman modelleri geliştirme çağrısı yapıldı. Eylemciler, gazeteciliğin korunmasının yalnızca medya çalışanlarının değil, demokratik toplumun tamamının sorumluluğu olduğunu vurguladı.




(MMY/HA)

author: Brian Hioe
title: Taichung Mayoral Debate Emphasizes International Prestige
content:
THE TAICHUNG MAYORAL debate was held on November 17th. The two primary candidates were Ho Hsin-chun of the DPP and Johnny Chiang of the KMT. Ho was first to speak, followed by Chiang.

Ho began by criticizing Chiang and outgoing KMT Taichung mayor Lu Shiow-yen for attempting to convince the public falsely that the DPP would end subsidies to the elderly. Ho then went on to point to Taichung’s growing role as Taiwan’s second-largest city, but that issues involving traffic jams and poor transportation infrastructure were increasingly visible. This included addressing congestion on highways, as well as finishing the MRT Blue Line, and increasing international links through the Taichung International Airport. Likewise, Ho stated that there needed to be more subsidies and government policy to assist young people and provide them with opportunities. Ho suggested that the KMT administration of Taichung had stalled progress, but that, in government, she would be able to allow for coordination between the central government and local government.

Johnny Chiang stressed his love of Taichung, as well as his successes in the past in winning international productions to visit Taichung to film. Chiang stated that he was motivated to improve Taichung in running for office, and that he hoped for Taichung to become an internationally esteemed city. This would allow local Taichung products to go abroad. Chiang, too, stated that Taichung must become a smart city through the incorporation of AI with automation. To this extent, Chiang also stated that he hoped to speed up commutes in Taichung, so that residents had more time, and that young people needed opportunities. Chiang stated that he hoped to allow young people to feel that having children was not a burden and that they did not have to make a choice between their work and having children, as a result of which he would seek to renovate education facilities in Taichung. Chiang claimed that he already had a blueprint for implementing changes.

When questioned by experts in the Q-and-A section about further developing Taichung, Ho stressed plans to expand venues for baseball and entertainment, so as to connect Taichung with international touring for large-scale performances. Chiang touted the accomplishments of his predecessor, Lu Shiow-yen, in terms of developing venues, as well as exercise centers. Chiang stated that such development would continue, as well as that he would continue Lu’s emphasis on sustainable development. When asked about priority policies, Ho again stressed transportation, while criticizing lack of progress and the waste of money due to slow progress on transportation infrastructure. Chiang, contrastingly, stressed urban safety and the health of the citizens, including a focus on boosting and allowing more access to vaccinations, as well as promoting exercise. Chiang also compared Taichung to LA in terms of development and suggested that the growth of the city would need to take patterns of urban development into account.

In closing statements, Ho stressed bipartisanship and that she would seek to help all residents of Taichung regardless of political views. Ho stated that she hoped Taichung could be a safe urban environment for children and the elderly, and that young people could find jobs they enjoyed and which could support themselves.

Chiang thanked supporters and stated that he hoped to build a better Taichung with them. Chiang stated that he hoped to see more hi-tech jobs in Taichung and that Taichung could become a place where young people would not have to leave the city for opportunities. Chiang, too, stated that he hoped to develop museums and cultural activities for young people.

One notes that between Ho and Chiang, both emphasized similar needs for the city. There was a large degree of overlap between the two’s policy proposals, though Chiang sometimes focused more on a vision for Taichung rather than specific proposals. Chiang also managed to cite the accomplishments of his predecessor, Lu Shiow-yen, without being reliant on appeals to her legacy. But Chiang was perhaps the better orator in the debate and, in many ways, the race is his to lose if he is able to coast off of Lu’s legacy.

author: CNT Sevilla
title: Entre la ignorancia y maldad
content:
“Definición: del latín definitio, -onis.

 […] 

2.- f. Proposición que expone con claridad y exactitud los caracteres genéricos y diferenciales de

 

algo material o inmaterial.”




Definir es la asignatura pendiente de la sociedad capitalista actual. Bueno, no exactamente. Atender a las definiciones con exactitud y responsabilidad lo es. Las palabras como Feminismo, Poliamor, Política, Estoicismo, etc… Son una marabunta de ideas arremolinadas en la mente de cada cual que han sido manoseadas por tantos y cuantos idiotas hemos ido dejando opinar a nuestro alrededor, siendo muy pocas (o ninguna) las veces que hemos permitido que alguien avezado/a y conocedor/a nos ilustrase en ello. Esto no ocurre sólo con grandes ideas sacadas de algún manual de filosofía para 2º de bachillerato. Esto ocurre con las cosas más tontas y rutinarias de nuestras vidas.




Es en las definiciones cuando realmente encontramos la raíz de cada tema y nos forjamos una visión responsable y madura del mismo.




No soy filólogo, y aunque me divierte como al que más el debate de dónde nacen las palabras (¿surgen de la necesidad social o derivan a ésta?), lo que no se puede evitar reconocer es que existen y delimitan algo. Si vas a una página cualquiera del diccionario y eliges una palabra al azar, como la de la cita más arriba, su definición te dirá lo que es, y a la misma vez lo que no es. Esto cobra sentido cuando lo piensas durante un momento: especifica lo que es, y, por ende, lo que 

no

 es.




Pero entonces ¿por qué según a quién preguntes sobre una definición te dice una cosa y otra? ¿Estás diciendo que todos somos unos ignorantes? ¿Significa que para ser una persona responsable debería conocer todas las definiciones de todas las cosas?




Pues es que la cosa está entre la ignorancia y la maldad, sinceramente. Aunque no me refiero sólo a la nuestra.




Decía George Lakoff en su libro «No pienses en un Elefante», que toda palabra tiene en nuestro cerebro un marco cognitivo. Propio al cerebro de cada cual. Así que cuando alguien te habla de la Libertad, pues a cada cual le sale un conjunto personal de ideas. El concepto de Libertad no es igual el que tiene un niño palestino que sobrevive en el West Bank a los bombardeos de los colonos sionistas, que el concepto de Libertad que maneja una mujer blanca adinerada de Washington DC. Y como no son iguales, cada cual reacciona a las palabras de diferente forma, sí.




Esto es inevitable y además no es malo per se. Quicir, todos nos vemos abocados a vivir, experimentar, errar y asumir; y todo esto enriquece nuestros marcos de cada una de las palabras que usamos (y también en cada idioma que usamos). Es parte de la plasticidad cerebral, y nos da margen para mejorar.




PERO.




El problema llega cuando no somos diligentes a la hora de gestionar dichos marcos y subcontratamos nuestras ideas por las de alguien más, en específico, alguien más tonto o malvado.




Durante años vamos apartando trabajar en las definiciones de las cosas complejas. O durante la ESO, o en la facultad, o en las discusiones familiares. Es que cansa. Y surgen en debates demasiado personales. Nuestros marcos cognitivos personales chocan con los de nuestra interlocutora/o, pero difieren en cosas tan sutiles y complejas que el debate se complica, y claro; ¿quién quiere tener debates sesudos un domingo por la tarde estando en casa de mamá para comer? ¿Quién quiere utilizar el tiempo de descanso tras un turno de 9 horas para discutir con su pareja sobre el alcance de la cultura machista en el ámbito de la investigación farmacéutica? No es culpa nuestra, la vida tiene muchas cosas por hacer y la media de personas trabajadoras bastante tenemos con mantener la poca cordura que manejamos. Suele ser más fácil transformar estos debates en discusiones socráticas enfocadas en el “o gano yo o él”, o ver un vídeo en una red social que suene a cómo yo pienso sobre algo.







El ignorante







Y he aquí el problema. Cuando en lugar de leer la definición de lo que es y no es el tema de se habla, pues dejamos espacio a que cualquiera nos deje sus ideas en nuestros marcos. Es decir, cambiamos nuestras experiencias, opinión y libre pensamiento por las ideas de otra persona. Y la amplia cantidad de veces, sin siquiera macerarlo o pasar nuestras conclusiones por el Departamento de Montaje. Bombardeo de ideas tontas o malvadas en redes sociales, comentarios estúpidos junto a la máquina del café en la oficina, o tu cuñado cuando opina de lo que jamás experimentó. Nos dejamos llevar por cansancio y porque a veces lo que dicen suena muy de acuerdo a nuestros sesgos (esas ideas preconcebidas e irracionales que todos tenemos sobre lo que no tenemos ni maldita idea) y así poco a poco esas ideas van quedándose a vivir en nuestros marcos cognitivos para siempre.




Es por eso, Miguel Ángel, que replicas cosas que escuchaste en un pódcast de ejercicio matutino y tu mujer se pregunta cuándo te volviste un fascistilla de medio pelo mientras criabáis a las gemelas… Subrogaste tu pensamiento a una gestora “independiente” que “sabe de lo que habla” y ahora te suena razonable cosas como eso de que “las mujeres tienen una edad útil y fértil desde los 17 a los 25 y que después de eso pues se convierten en gente sin valor que no vale la pena tratar de ligar”. La subrogación siendo motor de problemas ejemplo 36586529384601. Sorpresa 0.




En definitiva, si dejas de pensar desde la raíz de la definición (que para algo hay lingüistas que las recogen en los maravillosos diccionarios, cojones) y dejas de trabajarte tú tu opinión desde la base y el razonamiento, pues llega alguien intencionado (malo) o alguien que se dejó llevar antes que tú (ignorante) e implanta sus ideas en tu coco. Adivina quién pasa a ser el ignorante en ese momento, máquina. Es cuando no hacemos esto (leer las definiciones, acudir a las personas estudiosas del tema, trabajar la opinión crítica y el razonamiento lógico) cuando obtenemos problemas sociales y personales.







Cambiamos nuestras experiencias, opinión y libre pensamiento por las ideas de otra persona.







Es así como obtenemos, por ejemplo, una caterva de musculitos misóginos que hablan de ser estoico tratando como basura a las demás personas que no son como ellos (o no se dejan arrastrar a estafas piramidales, claro). Ignorantes que hablan de «feminazis» como si ese término tuviese algún sentido (como toda la mierda que piensan). O cretinos y cretinas que llaman «rojo» o comunista a un político Socialista Liberal Capitalista (que ya hay que ser ignorante…).




Por no hablar de quienes piensan que la Anarquía es la ausencia de reglas y normas y todos los anarquistas somos gente caótica, impetuosa, vengativa y violenta. Y algunos lo somos, ojo, pero no más que cualquier creyente cristiano o judío promedio, colega.




Todo esto queda retratado con muchísima más claridad cuando llegan las elecciones o los medios se hacen eco de lo que hace Israel por enésima vez sobre el pueblo palestino. O cuando hay un desahucio (como el de Mari Carmen hace unas semanas) o cuando las televisiones pagadas con dinero privado y subvencionadas con dinero público tienen cierta tendencia a decirte que cuidado con los okupas porque se te meterán en el piso de la playa cuando mires hacia otro lado.




Así mismo escuchamos a 

sionistas

 hablando de antisemitismo cuando se les llama fascistas y claro… Si has ido posponiendo lo de pensar y razonar, y de repente te ves envuelto en una conversación incómoda con un sionista, pues te quedas con las patas colgando:







El mundo está lleno de ignorantes que andamos por la calle sin saber de un millón de cosas







-Un momento. ¿Por qué me está llamando ese judío a mí antisemita cuando sólo estoy

 

diciendo que se deje de masacrar críos en Gaza, que tristemente es ya un campo de concentración?

 Claro Teresa, y ahora ¿por dónde empiezas ahora a recopilar info para seguir la discusión? ¿Cómo te recuperas de haber dejado tu cerebro aparcado en el garaje de un ignorante?




Parafraseando a un compañero mexicano: no nos hagamos pato en esto. Somos responsables de lo que sabemos y lo que no. Somos responsables por cuanto sale de nuestra boca, pero también por cuanto nos quedamos de lo que oímos (que ni escuchar siquiera a veces). El mundo está lleno (tristemente) de ignorantes que andamos por la calle sin saber de un millón de cosas, pero ^*¨¿?, no echemos cuenta al primer imbécil que se nos cruce o nos guste cómo dice las cosas. Y es que ignorantes somo muchos, pero no podemos dejar atrás ni pasar de puntillas de la mitad del colectivo que se beneficia de nuestra poca diligencia mental: las personas malvadas.







El malvado







La maldad en este contexto es la influencia que algunos ejercen sobre ti y tus marcos para sumarte a sus filas acólitos de amebas mentales. Gente (no os consideran personas) a quienes «guían» en pos de un «bien» ideal en el que se hará «lo correcto». Lo que a ellos les salga de la genitalia, vamos. Venga, ejemplito, que así se entiende mejor: Libertad.




– “Viva la Libertad, carajo”- Milei, eslógan de campaña elecciones de Argentina, 2023.




– “Congress shall make no law respecting an establishment of religion, or prohibiting the free exercise thereof; or abridging the freedom of speech, or of the press; or the right of the people peaceably to assemble, and to petition the Government for a redress of grievances.” – Primera Enmienda de la Constitución de los Estados Unidos de América.




1. Se reconocen y protegen los derechos:




a)

 A expresar y difundir libremente los pensamientos, ideas y opiniones mediante la palabra, el escrito o cualquier otro medio de reproducción.




b)

 A la producción y creación literaria, artística, científica y técnica.  




c)

 A la libertad de cátedra.




d)

 A comunicar o recibir libremente información veraz por cualquier medio de difusión. La ley regulará el derecho a la cláusula de conciencia y al secreto profesional en el ejercicio de estas libertades.




2. El ejercicio de estos derechos no puede restringirse mediante ningún tipo de censura previa.” -Extracto del Artículo 20 de la Constitución Española actual.




Estoy seguro de que ya más o menos entendéis por dónde estoy yendo. La definición de Libertad de cada pueblo, y la coherencia de sus gobiernos a la hora de permitir expresiones que no nos suenen bien. Tenemos represiones en todos los países anteriormente citados. Cuando hay manifestaciones, expresiones de opinión contra Israel o cuando se opina libremente sobre el derecho al aborto. Libertad, sí, pero con condiciones.







Los límites de mi lenguaje significan los límites de mi mundo







Mis lectores mexicanos sabrán de la existencia del Temach, su calva y la inmundicia machista de la que hace gala. Y sus palabras de “yo soy feminista y porque creo en la libertad de las mujeres también digo que ellas han de ser muy responsables con la suya”. Como si no estuviese dando a saber que es un cerdo machista en esa oración cuyo sujeto es “yo” y el atributo es “soy gilipollas”.




Cada vez que Abascal es llamado “de derechas” o Pedro Sánchez es llamado “socialista” y Milei “anarcocapitalista” me quiero morir. Definiciones, por favor.




-Milei no es un anarcocapitalista, es un turbocapitalista antirregulacionista económico.




-Y Abascal es un fascista. Ni de derechas ni izquierdas: Fascista, como su padre.




Ninguno de ellos, como ninguno de los imbéciles que te encuentras normalmente en la vida, hacen cosas de forma malvada por el simple hecho de ser malvados. Creen que hacen un bien mayor. Bien mayor del que suelen excluir con demasiada frecuencia y alegría a todo lo que no es como ellos: palestinos, negras, mujeres, gays, trans, regulacionistas, ecologistas, etc.… es esa creencia de sentirse legitimados por ese bien mayor el que les “ayuda” a hacer sacrificios (cuyo precio no pagan ellos, sino los grupos anteriormente expuestos).




Aun así, hay grupos que sí reconocen abiertamente que son malvados. Y en mi libertad de opinión digo que me encantaría verles picar hielo en Siberia para mi granizado de limón.




Llegados a este punto, y después del bombardeo de cosas que he dicho, me gustaría que quedase algo claro: conoced las definiciones.




Si piensas que el Feminismo es un movimiento que busca la ridiculización del hombre y la compensación violenta y unilateral por parte de las mujeres es que o bien eres ignorante o bien buscas un beneficio personal vendiendo cursos de masculinidad estoica. Y no me malinterpretes: tan poco feminista e igualitario es quien cree que las “mujere son poblema, gñé” como la que realmente piensa que “ahora es el momento de hacerles pasar a los hombres lo que nosotras hemos pasado”. Ambos lados de este espectro son o ignorantes o malvados.




Dijo Wittgenstein que “

los límites de mi lenguaje significan los límites de mi mundo

”. Pues hacedle caso y mirad las definiciones de las cosas, no lo que otros definan por ti. Que este tipo era muy listo.




Hoy sería un buen día para dejar de ser una marioneta y recuperar la independencia y madurez que tienes. Hoy es un buen día para pensar por libre y ser crítico. Hoy es un buen día para reconocer el esfuerzo de tus maestras/os que se esforzaban en enseñarte a pensar solo. Y también para un té con leche. Y un brownie de chocolate. Y tu emancipación cerebral.







La entrada 

Entre la ignorancia y maldad

 apareció primero en 

CNT Sevilla

.

Entre la ignorancia y maldad

 se publicó primero en 

Confederación Nacional del Trabajo

.

author: Unknown
title: Festina Lente: "Lez bike, lê hêdî hêdî" an jî "Hêdî hêdî lez bike"
content:
“Tiştê ku bi lez tê avakirin, mayînde nabe; lê tiştê ku bi aqil, sebr û hişmendiyê tê avakirin, dikare bibe bingeha pêşerojeke mayînde.”




Di jiyana mirovan de her dem xwestekek heye ku em bigihîjin tiştên ku em dixwazin. Mirov dixwaze pêş bikeve, biguherê, bigihîje armancên xwe û di jiyana xwe de encamên mezin bistîne. Ev xwestek di xwezaya mirovan de heye. Lê pir caran di nav vê xwestekê de em rastiyeke girîng ji bîr dikin: Her tişt bi lez nayê bidestxistin û her gava bilez ne gaveke pêşketinê ye.




Em di serdemekê de dijîn ku her tişt dixwaze zû pêk were. Dem, zext, pêşbazî û xwesteka gihîştina encaman, mirovan dikin ku bêyî ku pir li ser encamên tevgerên xwe bifikirin, gav bavêjin. Lê jiyan, bi taybetî jiyana civakî, her tim bi lez û bez nayê rêvebirin. Tiştên ku bingehên wan kûr in, pêdiviya wan bi dem, sebr, aqil û têgihiştinê heye.




Festina lente

 gotineke Latînî ye ku wateya wê “

Hêdî hêdî bileze

” an jî “Bilez be, lê bi sebr û hişmendî tevbigere” ye. Ev gotin di xwe de paradoksekê, ango dijberiyeke xuya, dihewîne. Lê dema em kûrtir li wateya wê dinêrin, dibînin ku ev gotin ne tenê şêwazeke tevgerê ye, belkî felsefeyeke jiyanê ye.




Festina lente ji me re dibêje ku mirov divê di armancên xwe de biryardar û bi cesaret be, lê di rêya gihîştina wan de ji aqil, sebr û hişmendiyê dûr nekeve. Bilezbûn divê bi bêaqilî re neyê tevlihevkirin. Lez divê bi rêxistin, hesab, nirxandin û berpirsiyariyê re be. Ji ber ku a girîng ne tenê ew e ku em bigihîjin armancekê, a girîng ew e ku em bi çi awayî digihîjin wê armancê.




Di jiyanê de hin dem hene ku pêdivî bi bilez tevger kirinê heye. Hin dem jî hene ku rawestan, fikirîn û li ser biryarên xwe ji nû ve nihêrîn pêwîst e. Mirovê ku van her du deman baş nas dike, dikare bi awayekî serkeftî jiyana xwe birêve bibe.




Lezkirin carinan mirovan dixe nav biryarên şaş. Mirov bêyî ku şert û mercan baş binirxîne, ji aliyê hestên xwe ve tê birêvebirin. Lê sebra bêarmanc jî dikare bibe sedema rawestan û windakirina derfetên girîng. Ji ber vê yekê pêdivî bi hevsengiyekê heye: Ne bilezbûneke bêhiş û ne jî sebreke bêdawî; lê tevgeriyeke bi armanc, bi aqil û bi berpirsiyarî.




Festina lente hunera dîtina vê hevsengiyê ye. Ew hînî me dike ku kengê divê em gavên xwe bilez bikin û kengê divê em rawestin û ji nû ve bifikirin.




Ev felsefe tenê ji bo jiyana kesane nîne. Di jiyana civakî û di pêvajoyên guherînê de jî xwedî wateyeke kûr e.




Civak bi biryarên yek an çend kesan nayê avakirin. Civak ji mirovan, bîranînên wan, êşên wan, hêviyên wan, çand, ziman, nirx û têkiliyên wan pêk tê. Dema ku civakek derbasî pêvajoyeke nû dibe, divê hem rabirdûya xwe nas bike û hem jî pêşeroja xwe bi awayekî hişmendî ava bike.




Ji nû ve avakirina civakê tenê guhertina saziyên heyî nîne. Ew di heman demê de ji nû ve avakirina têkiliyên mirovan, zêdekirina baweriyê, bihêzkirina hişmendiya hevpar û pêşxistina çandeke nû ya hevjiyanê ye.




Civakek ku bi salan rastî şer, pevçûn, cudahî, bêbawerî û birîndarî bûye, nikare bi biryarekê hemû birînên xwe bide başkirin. Ji bo vê yekê pêdivî bi dem, guhdarîkirin, naskirina êşên hevdu, vegotina rastiyan û avakirina baweriyê heye.




Bawerî bi gotinan tenê nayê avakirin; bi tevgerên rast, bi edaletê, bi wekheviyê û bi berpirsiyariyê tê avakirin. Ji ber vê yekê pêvajoyên aştiyê divê ne tenê li ser peyman û biryarên siyasî bimînin, lê divê di nav civakê de jî bingehekî xurt bistînin.




Aştî tenê rawestandina şer û bêdengiya çekan nîne. Aştiya rastîn ew e ku mirov bikaribe bê tirs bijî, mafên xwe biparêze, bi nasname û çanda xwe bijî, bi dengê xwe bêje û bi kesên din re di çarçoveya rêzgirtin û wekheviyê de hevjiyanê bike.




Aştî pêvajoyeke civakî, exlaqî û mirovî ye. Ew pêdivî bi guhdarîkirina hevdu, qebûlkirina cudahiyan, edalet, maf û azadiyên bingehîn heye. Di vê pêvajoyê de divê mirov ji hişmendiya dijminatiyê derbasî hişmendiya hevjiyanê bibe.




Lê ev guherîn bi zorê û bi lez pêk nayê. Mirov nikare ji civakekê ku bi salan di nav bêbaweriyê de jiyaye, bixwaze ku di demeke kurt de hemû tiştan ji bîr bike. Divê êş bê guhdarîkirin, birîn bêne nasîn, bêedaletî bêne nirxandin û ji bo siberojeke dadwer  bê vekirin.




Li vir jî Festina lente wateya xwe dide: Ji bo avakirina aştiyê lez bike, lê ewqas jî hişmend be ku bingeha wê bi bawerî, edalet û rêzgirtinê were avakirin.




Her guherîneke mayînde berî her tiştî di hişmendiya mirovan de dest pê dike. Mirov divê pêşî xwe biguherîne, paşê dikare têkiliyên xwe û cîhana derdora xwe jî biguherîne.




Hînkirin û perwerdehiya civakî di vê pêvajoyê de xwedî roleke girîng i. Perwerde ne tenê wergirtina agahiyan e; ew pêvajoya fêmkirina jiyanê, naskirina mafan, fêrbûna berpirsiyariyê, pêşxistina hişmendiya rexneyî û avakirina têgihiştina hevpar e.




Civakek ku dixwaze pêşerojeke nû ava bike, divê xwe ji nû ve perwerde bike. Divê mirov fêr bibin ku guhdarî bikin, bi awayekî azad bifikirin, cudahiyan wek dewlemendiyê bibînin û pirsgirêkan bi rêya diyalog û hevfêmkirinê çareser bikin.




Guherîna civakê bêyî beşdariya mirovan nayê pêkanîn. Her kes divê xwe wek beşek ji çareseriyê bibîne, ne tenê wek temaşevanê bûyeran.




Em gelek caran li ser encamên mezin disekinin û girîngiya gavên piçûk ji bîr dikin. Lê dîrok nîşan dide ku gelek guhertinên mezin bi gavên piçûk dest pê dikin.




Dara mezin bi yek rojê mezin nabe. Pêşî tov tê çandin, paşê kokên wê di bin axê de xurt dibin, piştî wê şax û pelên wê derdikevin. Di vê pêvajoyê de dem û sebr pêwîst in. Heke mirov tovê îro biçîne û sibê li benda daran be, dê ji xwezaya jiyanê tiştekî fêm ne kiribe.




Civak wisa ye. Civakeke bihêz li ser perwerde, çalakî, hevkariyê, edalet û berpirsiyariya hevbeş ava dibe. Her gaveke biçûk û hişmend dikare bibe bingeha guhertineke mezin.




Divê em ji encamên zû şaş nebin û ji derengmayîna hin pêvajoyan hêvîya xwe winda nekin. Girîng ew e ku em di rêya rast de bin û gavên xwe bêarmanc neavêjin.




Di çanda me ya rojane de, rawestandin pir caran wekî gavek paşveçûnê tê dîtin. Lê ne her rawestandin gavek paşveçûn e. Carinan, rawestandin derfetek nû ye ku meriv bifikire, binirxîne û rêya rast bibîne.




Mirovê ku her tim direve, dibe ku nizanibe ew ber bi ku ve diçe. Lê mirovê ku carinan bisekine, li dora xwe binêre û armanca xwe ji nû ve binirxîne, dikare rêya xwe baştir bibîne.




Di jiyana kesane de jî, di têkiliyên civakî de jî û di pêvajoyên siyasî de jî ev rastî derbasdar e. Bêyî nirxandina xeletiyan, fêrbûna ji rabirdûyê û naskirina kêmasiyan, pêşketineke mayînde pêk nayê.




Ji ber vê yekê, carinan divê em ji xwe bipirsin: Em tenê dixwazin zû bigihîjin encamê, an jî dixwazin encameke rast û mayînde bidest bixin?




Ev pirs dikare rêya me biguherîne.




Pêşeroj ne tiştek e ku tenê em li benda hatina wê bimînin. Pêşeroj tiştek e ku em îro bi tevgerên xwe ava dikin. Her biryar, her gotin, her gav û her têkiliya me dikare bandorê li ser pêşerojê bike.




Heke em dixwazin civakeke azad, demokratîk, adil û bi rêz ji bo hevdu ava bikin, divê îro jî bi heman nirxan bijîn. Divê di navbera gotin û kirinên me de hevgirtin hebe. Divê rêzgirtina ji mirovan, edalet, wekhevî, azadî û berpirsiyarî bibin bingehên tevgerên me.




Em nikarin bi awayekî bêedaletî li benda avakirina civakeke adil bin. Em nikarin bêyî guhdarîkirina hevdu li benda hevfêmkirinê bin. Em nikarin bêyî beşdariya hemû beşên civakê li benda pêşerojeke hevpar bin.




Ji ber vê yekê pêdivî ye ku em hem xwedî cesaret bin û hem jî xwedî sebr; hem xwedî hêvî bin û hem jî xwedî aqil; hem ji bo guherînê bixebitin û hem jî girîngiya avakirina bingeha wê bizanin.




Festina lente di dawiyê de ji me re felsefeyeke sade lê kûr dihêle: Di jiyanê de divê em ne ji armancên xwe dûr bikevin û ne jî ji ber lezê rêya xwe winda bikin.




Bilez bin di biryardayînê de, lê di nirxandinê de sebr bikin. Xwedî cesaret bin di guherînê de, lê di avakirina wê de aqilmend bin. Ji bo pêşerojê bixebitin, lê rabirdûyê jî ji bîr nekin. Hêvî bikin, lê hêviyê bi ked û berpirsiyariyê ve girêbidin.




Ji ber ku jiyana mirovan ne tenê bi bidestxistina armancan e; ew di heman demê de bi wê yekê ve girêdayî ye ku em çawa di wê rêyê de dimeşin. Girîng e ku em mirovahiya xwe biparêzin, wijdanê xwe zindî bihêlin û di rê de nirxên xwe ji bîr nekin.




Bila em ji bo guherînê bilez bin, lê di avakirina wê de sebr bikin. Bila em ji bo aştiyê bixebitin, lê bingehên wê bi edalet û baweriyê ava bikin. Werin em ber bi pêşerojê ve biçin, lê niha bi hestek berpirsiyariyê bijîn.




Ji ber ku armanca me ne tenê gihîştina sibê ye; armanca me afirandina siberojek çêtir ji bo hemû mirovan e.

author: winter oak
title: The island that broke free
content:
A book review by Paul Cudenec, who reads it 

here




“Every word that comes from your speaking hole is a lie in some form”. [1]




“You, the self-designated Elite of this planet, brought to your position moreso by your own lack of what is understood in most places as morality and your willingness over millennia to steal and cheat and perform the most barbaric crimes… have betrayed your trust about as fully as any trust could be betrayed”. [2]




Dave Patterson does not mince his words in 

Greenways

 – the first of two “

Green Island

” books – which although a work of fiction features a large amount of truth.




The basis of the novel is that Prince Edward Island in eastern Canada has partly broken away from the rest of the country after a surprise election result that ended the old two-party hold on power.




It has renamed itself Green Island and started organising society in a very different way to the previous status quo.




Now, the description of a stable and mainly happy society (not quite a Utopia, but heading that way) could have been as dull as ditchwater over the nearly 600 pages of Patterson’s work.










But he does a great job in making the book a lively read. For a start, his style (or styles, because he adopts many different registers according to who is speaking or writing) is one of anything but terse concision – ebullient eloquence would be nearer the mark and there is plenty of humour as well.




Neither is Patterson of the social realist school, as evidenced by the way that the island attracts the interest and presence of 

Henry David Thoreau

, [3] Thomas More, Thomas Paine and Che Guevera and that the trial of the global elite featured in the opening citations is conducted by a divine presence called The One, accompanied by the blindfolded figure of Justice herself.




There are several distinct threads advancing through the pages, including chapters consisting of fragments and thought-provoking quotations from famous thinkers.




I will share a few of the latter to give you a flavour:







“Do not go where the path may lead; go instead where there is no path and leave a trail”. Ralph Waldo Emerson. [4]










“Whatever you do will seem insignificant, but it is very important to do it”. 

Mohandas Gandhi

. [5]










“Justice is conscience, not a personal conscience but the conscience of the whole of humanity. Those who clearly recognize the voice of their own conscience usually recognize also the voice of justice”. Alexander Solzhenitsyn. [6]










“The trade of governing has always been monopolised by the most ignorant and the most rascally individuals of mankind”. Thomas Paine. [7]










“When plunder becomes a way of life for a group of men living in society, they create for themselves, in the course of time, a legal system that authorizes it and a moral code that glorifies it”. Frédéric Bastiat. [8]













But there is also plenty of wisdom in 

Greenways

 to be found coming from the mouths, pens and keyboards of its various characters, all of which can of course be regarded as 

Dave Patterson

 quotations. Here are some of them:







“Strength guided by a reptilian mind is not conducive to advanced civilization”. [9]










“At all times the power of a tiny point of Light is such that it will dissipate darkness all around, but the power of a tiny point of darkness in a place where there is Light is insignificant”. [10]










“I remember still when we had plenty and freedom in our village here, and happiness and security and a good life in our families, and no ruler… It was a simpler life, to be sure, but one I know most would joyfully return to, rather than what we have now”. [11]










“After a certain period of training, the people embrace their chains, they love their chains, they hate those who try to free them!” [12]







That last one reminds me of the multiple occasions when I would be using a day off work (Saturdays, usually) to make a stand for freedom, only for some chain-loving passer-by to angrily call out: “

Getta job!

“.










Only five years into their new era, the islanders’ world is still not too different from our own, although they are proud to be “turning back some of the less pleasant aspects of modern industrial society”. [13]




Traffic has been reduced because of “a good reliable public transport system” [14] and they enjoy permaculture and organic market gardens. [15]




Since Green Island is a real democracy I find myself hoping that they will reverse themselves yet further out of the industrial dead-end and collectively decide that their airport, solar panels and wind turbines are not compatible with the restoration of natural harmony.




They are making a healthy start, anyway: “The people are coming from the cocoons and boxes in droves, turning off the sedating tvs and abandoning the meds and malls to finally start living lives of optimism and trust and honesty that come naturally to most people”. [16]




“It’s really quite amazing the amount of energy and ideas out there, that have been stifled for so long. We’re really like a wonderful flower – or strong tree, perhaps! – whose seed has been buried somewhere and not allowed to germinate, and now with the sunlight springing up almost overnight, joyously full of life”. [17]




“We’ve let the people out of a dark dungeon into the true light for the first time in their lives, and there is no way they are going back”. [18]










There is a strong sense of social justice in the imagined breakaway society, which Patterson uses to expose the lack of it in the world we inhabit.




“On Green Island, for instance, you will never find, anymore, a situation of a common factory employee making barely enough money in a full week of hard work to pay for the cheapest food and substandard housing, while the exalted CEO takes home a million or two dollars per week, plus a bonus of tens of millions at the end of the year and a golden parachute of hundreds of millions after a couple of years of driving the business into the ground – such things are common in Canada or the US, but really they’re signs of a severely dysfunctional system, a system based on various kinds of elitism and fraud and lies and corruption and rule by your secretive uber-elite, which we have basically managed to get rid of here, through the open we-the-people government system”. [19]




The whole point of the novel is to simultaneously condemn contemporary society and propose a sane alternative, so the author often uses the same device.




He says, for example: “The aesthetics of living pleasurably were always considered by the people who planned things on Green Island, unlike the previous systems where the efficient acquistion of money was the driving force, and little attention paid at all to making things pleasant for the people”. [20]




He has an elderly resident declare: “It’s altogether a new idea, you know, making our own decisions as a community and actually having the government do what we want rather than having them politicians sitting on the stage and telling us what they’re going to do whether or not we much approve”. [21]










And on the issue of education, he says the “old” system was “the human equivalent of dog obedience school, where children were, and still are in most places, taught primarily one thing – to go somewhere every day in the morning and do what they are told to do all day, without asking questions”. [22]




More broadly, we learn: “What we have done here, the huge accomplishment, is that we have removed (or mostly removed, there are still some lingering pockets of illness) the ‘uber-layer’ as someone called it, that great invisible sucking vacuum above us all that used to suck half of everything we did or produced straight into the bank accounts of a gang of bankers and ‘investors’ (read ‘crooks’, from my perspective) – imagine if you had some big parasite on your back, taking half your blood every day, half your food, half your energy, imagine how you’d feeel if that lump was removed, and that’s what we have done for Green Island – and it’s fabulous”. [23]




As will be apparent from the above passage, the “golden goose treadmill” [24] of the bankster class is an evil which Patterson rightly identifies as a crucially important one – “the greatest scam in all of human history”. [25]




He adds: “And the same people who own the banks, and some other wealthy ‘investors’, own the newspapers so the newspapers won’t talk about it, and they bribe the politicians so the politicians don’t talk about it”. [26]




Patterson asks: “Do you think that if the government is short of money it should allow commercial banks to create the money and then borrow it from them at prime rates of interest which you will pay for with your taxes, or that the government might better create that money itself?”. [27]










One Green Islander tells a young visitor: “Last count I saw – get a grip on something here, boy, this is a biggie – the Canadian banks had collected over a TRILLION dollars in interest on 

just

 the so-called Canadian National Debt just during the last 25 years or so, a trillion dollars of the tax money paid by your folks and every other Canadian taxpayer, a trillion dollars your folks should NOT have paid, it was really stolen”. [28]




And Patterson explains the sinister and pernicious effect of the interest attached to the money circulating in our society, which amounts to a deliberate long-term dispossession by usury.




“When banks create 98% (give or take!) of your money supply, and demand collateral and interest – well, where does the interest come from?




“They create the principal, but not the interest. Time comes to pay interest, and although all the players shuffle around the money, eventually, like a big game of musical chairs, someone cannot find interest, and collateral goes to banks.




“Every year, a lot of people cannot find interest and collateral goes to banks. Every year interest, every year collateral to banks. Over time – well, you can see where it is heading, I am sure. The slow, but ever faster, turning over of all property in your society to the banks – or, more correctly of course, the ‘investors’ who own the banks”. [29]










Finally, I was delighted to read how divine justice is meted out to a leading figure in this usurious criminal enterprise, the head of certain notorious banking dynasty by the name of Shield, who admits to having led humanity along the path “to the New World Order we have implemented today”. [30]




The One thunders angrily in the courtroom: “What would you have to say about that, Banker? About the many, nay the countless!, dreams, great and small, you have destroyed cruelly over the years, as your ancestors gathered their gold, and spread their lies, and turned the pure dreams of the people into the darkness and pain of the satanic mill in the name of this gold, into the endless slaughter of the battlefield in the pursuit of this gold, into the destruction of this endlessly beautiful planet its very self, all in the name of the pursuit of this gold?!!”. [31]




Recommended further reading: 

Enemies of the People: The Rothschilds and their corrupt global empire

. [32]










[1] Dave Patterson, 

Greenways

 (Green Island Book 1), (Green Island Books, 2026. Original edition 2009), p. 284, 

https://www.rudemacedon.ca/greenisland.html

 All subsequent page references are to this work.

[2] p. 151.

[3] 

https://orgrad.wordpress.com/a-z-of-thinkers/henry-david-thoreau/

[4] p. 493.

https://orgrad.wordpress.com/a-z-of-thinkers/mohandas-gandhi/

author: Duda Sousa
title: Agenda da semana: Câmara vota ajuste fiscal de Lula e STF debate direitos indígenas
content:
A Câmara dos Deputados começa a semana com a apreciação e votação do polêmico pacote de ajuste fiscal apresentado pelo governo Lula.

 O presidente da Casa, Hugo Motta (Republicanos-PB), convocou uma sessão extraordinária para esta segunda-feira (23), às 18h, com o objetivo de iniciar a análise do 

Projeto de Lei Complementar

 (PLP) 299/2026, aprovado pelo Senado na última quarta-feira (18). O governo pretende concluir a votação na Câmara sem alterações no texto, evitando que a proposta precise retornar aos senadores.




Conhecido como plano Moretti, em referência ao ministro do Planejamento e Orçamento, Bruno Moretti, o projeto amplia os mecanismos de controle das despesas públicas. Entre as medidas estão a possibilidade de novos bloqueios de recursos, a redução de benefícios tributários e a diminuição, em determinadas condições, do limite de crescimento real dos gastos federais de 2,5% para 2%. O governo estima que as mudanças possam melhorar o resultado das contas públicas em até R$ 56,1 bilhões em 2027.




No Senado, a Comissão de Educação e Cultura deve discutir, na quarta-feira (25), as prioridades orçamentárias para a educação em 2027.

 Até o meio-dia desta segunda, os parlamentares poderão apresentar sugestões de emendas à Lei de Diretrizes Orçamentárias (LDO), que orienta a elaboração do orçamento federal. Encerrado esse prazo, caberá à comissão analisar as propostas recebidas e decidir quais serão aprovadas para encaminhamento à Comissão Mista de Orçamento do Congresso Nacional.




No Supremo Tribunal Federal (STF), os ministros têm julgamentos previstos para quarta e quinta-feira, dias 25 e 26, envolvendo direitos dos povos indígenas e proteção ambiental. 

Uma das ações questiona a exigência de consulta prévia às comunidades indígenas antes da realização de obras públicas que possam afetá-las, como a construção de estradas e a instalação de redes de energia elétrica. A Corte também deverá analisar dispositivos da Lei da Liberdade Econômica que permitem a autorização de atividades mesmo diante de possíveis impactos socioambientais. Outro julgamento previsto envolve as regras para a execução obrigatória de emendas parlamentares nos orçamentos estaduais.




De volta ao Brasil após compromissos internacionais, Lula terá pela frente as negociações para aprovar o ajuste fiscal e as articulações sobre a composição do governo para seu próximo mandato. Na última quinta-feira (19), o presidente assinou o decreto que regulamenta a nova escala de trabalho de cinco dias de atividade e dois de descanso, encerrando a 

escala 6×1

. A implementação da medida e a tramitação das propostas econômicas continuam entre os principais desafios políticos do Planalto.




Estão na agenda da semana de 23 a 27 de novembro:




DIREITOS HUMANOS







Câmara







Comissão Nacional Indígena da Verdade (CPOVOS, 24/11, 15h30):

 A Comissão realiza audiência pública sobre a criação de uma Comissão Nacional Indígena da Verdade. O debate abordará políticas de memória, justiça e reparação pelas violações de direitos cometidas contra povos indígenas, além de medidas para evitar que esses episódios se repitam. 




Violência sexual infantil e inteligência artificial (CEXEXPLO, 25/11, 14h):

 Audiência discute o uso de tecnologias para produzir e compartilhar materiais de abuso sexual infantil, incluindo imagens geradas por inteligência artificial. Representantes da Polícia Federal, do Unicef e de organizações de proteção à infância foram convidados para o debate.




Rede de proteção à infância (CEXEXPLO, 26/11, 9h):

 A comissão debate a distribuição e o funcionamento dos serviços de proteção de crianças e adolescentes no país. A audiência abordará a atuação dos conselhos tutelares, dos Centros de Referência Especializados de Assistência Social (Creas) e das delegacias especializadas, incluindo as dificuldades de atendimento em regiões com menor presença dessas instituições.




Mães atípicas (CDHMIR, 26/11, 14h):

 Parlamentares debatem as dificuldades enfrentadas por mães de pessoas com deficiência. A audiência, solicitada pela deputada Erika Kokay (PT-DF), terá representantes de movimentos sociais e órgãos públicos para discutir políticas de cuidado e proteção social.













MEIO AMBIENTE







Câmara







Educação ambiental e mudanças climáticas (CMADS, 26/11, 14h):

 A Comissão realiza seminário sobre o papel da educação ambiental no enfrentamento das emergências climáticas e dos eventos extremos no Brasil. O debate contará com representantes do Ministério do Meio Ambiente, educadores e pesquisadores.



















STF







Consulta prévia aos povos indígenas (25 e 26/11, 14h):

 Os ministros julgam ação proposta pelo governo de Roraima contra normas que exigem a consulta prévia às comunidades indígenas para a realização de obras de infraestrutura capazes de afetar seus territórios. A discussão envolve dispositivos da Convenção 169 da Organização Internacional do Trabalho (OIT).




Lei da Liberdade Econômica (25 e 26/11, 14h):

 Supremo analisa ação apresentada pelo PSB contra dispositivos da Lei 13.874/2019. O partido questiona a possibilidade de autorização automática de atividades econômicas quando órgãos públicos não respondem dentro do prazo previsto, inclusive em situações com possíveis impactos socioambientais.













POLÍTICA







Câmara







Facções criminosas e eleições (CSPCCO, 25/11, 14h):

 A Comissão realiza audiência sobre a influência de facções criminosas nas eleições e o controle territorial exercido por esses grupos. O debate foi solicitado pelos deputados General Pazuello (PL-RJ) e Hugo Leal (PSD-RJ).



















STF







Porte de armas para guardas municipais (25 e 26/11, 14h):

 O Supremo analisa uma ação que questiona dispositivos da legislação federal que autorizam o porte de armas de fogo por integrantes das guardas municipais.




Emendas parlamentares estaduais (25 e 26/11, 14h):

 Os ministros retomam a análise de ações que questionam regras de execução obrigatória de emendas parlamentares em estados como Mato Grosso, Paraíba e Rondônia. A discussão envolve os limites para a destinação de recursos pelos deputados estaduais e a autonomia dos governos na administração dos orçamentos.
















Agenda da semana da

 

Pública

 

é um serviço apresentado aos leitores, concebido com base nas informações dos portais da Câmara, Senado e STF.

author: Unknown
title: Adresse à notre bon maître La Boétie
content:
La Boétie, un moyen pour la bourgeoisie de se défausser sur le peuple de ses propres crimes et iniquités.




Dans la présentation de l'édition chez Payot (1976) du Discours de la servitude volontaire, Miguel Abensour et Marcel Gauchet commencent par noter que ce texte est considéré comme «

 

transparent quant au sens

 

». «

 

Présupposé de lecture universellement admis, ajoutent-ils. Machiavel vient-il en question, par exemple, il est classique de s'interroger pour décider s'il écrit à l'intention des tyrans ou, à l'inverse, de ceux qui ne savent pas afin de les éclairer. S'agissant de La Boétie, par contre, il n'y aurait pas lieu de se perdre en conjectures sur le sens de sa démonstration, ni sur les destinataires du Discours. Sans équivoque aucune, La Boétie écrirait du côté de la démocratie pour le peuple.

 

»




C'est ainsi donc que revoilà La Boétie sur les barricades. Enfin, son nom. Et le titre de son discours. Car La Boétie, lui, n'est jamais descendu dans la rue pour protester, ni pacifiquement, ni violemment. Il n'a non plus jamais eu faim, jamais eu besoin de travailler dur pour gagner sa vie, jamais eu de famille à prendre en charge, jamais eu à manquer d'un enseignement de qualité. Il est né dans une famille de magistrats, il a fait de brillantes études, bénéficié d'une dérogation du roi pour entrer comme conseiller au Parlement de Bordeaux deux ans avant l'âge légal. Il n'est donc pas surprenant qu'il trouve «

 

chose vraiment surprenante

 

» que «

 

tant d'hommes, tant de villes, tant de nations supportent quelquefois tout d'un Tyran seul, qui n'a de puissance que celle qu'on lui donne, qui n'a pouvoir de leur nuire qu'autant qu'ils veulent bien l'endurer.

 

» Car lui n'a connu que les privilèges de sa condition.




Désolée cher Étienne si bien né, si bien intentionné, mais apprends un peu la vie du peuple avant de parler. On voit bien que tu n'as pas été réprimé, violenté, mutilé, persécuté, torturé ou assassiné par les polices, les milices et les armées d'un tyran, pour penser qu'il est seul et sans pouvoir contre le peuple. Tu vois Étienne, ce qui me dérange, c'est que, n'ayant jamais eu à subir ce genre de choses – tant mieux pour toi

 

! – tu vois les peuples comme «

 

des millions de millions d'hommes, misérablement asservis, et soumis tête baissée, à un joug déplorable, non qu'ils y soient contraints par une force majeure, mais parce qu'ils sont fascinés et, pour ainsi dire, ensorcelés par le seul nom d'un

 

». Pardon pour ma familiarité, monsieur de La Boétie, mais je voudrais t'y voir, toi

 

!




Pourtant tu n'as pas complètement tort. Je vois bien que, fascinés par ton seul nom, passé de génération en génération sans que personne, comme le notent les préfaciers précités, n'interroge vraiment ta parole, certains aspirants révolutionnaires se soumettent à ton autorité, parce que les y embrigadent d'autres prestigieux personnages, qu'ils soient intellectuels, leaders politiques ou simplement professeurs chargés d'enseigner à des lycéens le programme, dont tu fais partie (crois-moi, tu ne serais pas au programme si le ministère te percevait comme dangereux pour l'ordre établi

 

!). Je dis bien certains et non pas tous les révolutionnaires. Car la vérité c'est que les vrais révolutionnaires, ceux qui agissent, se soucient peu de te lire, ou de s'entendre dire par toi qu'il suffit de vouloir être libre pour l'être – alors que pour libérer l'humanité ils endurent des difficultés dont tu n'as pas la moindre idée.




Il paraît que tu as écrit ton brillant petit texte à peine sorti de l'adolescence. Un garçon intelligent, nul doute là-dessus. Né et grandi à l'abri de tout. Avec un tout petit peu d'expérience de la vie, comment aurais-tu pu écrire des choses aussi naïves

 

? Croire que le tyran est seul contre tous, et que puisqu'il est «

 

le plus efféminé de la nation

 

», il est aisé de le faire tomber

 

! Mon ami, on voit que tu n'as jamais été une femme, ni un pauvre, ni un colonisé. Tu donnes des leçons de révolution comme les curés donnent aux jeunes mariés des leçons de sexualité. Dommage que tu n'aies pu rencontrer Rimbaud plutôt que Montaigne : il a su plus tard, lui, qu' «

 

on n'est pas sérieux quand on a dix-sept ans

 

». Mais non, ce n'est pas de ta faute. La faute en est aux adultes qui continuent à te prendre au sérieux quand ils prétendent défendre le peuple alors que dans ta naïveté d'enfant gâté, tu ne fais que culpabiliser le peuple en le convainquant que les crimes commis contre lui par les tyrans sont de sa faute.




«

 

Ce sont donc les peuples qui se laissent, ou plutôt se font garrotter, puisqu'en refusant seulement de servir, ils briseraient leurs liens

 

». Ben voyons, abracadabra

 

! Et tu insistes : «

 

C'est le peuple qui s'assujettit et se coupe la gorge : qui pouvant choisir d'être sujet ou d'être libre, repousse la liberté et prend le joug.

 

» C'est cela, oui, merci de la leçon notre bon maître

 

! Et puis il te faut l'accabler encore un peu plus, ce peuple où tu ne vois pas d'humains, seulement des animaux : «

 

S'il lui en coûtait quelque chose pour recouvrer sa liberté je ne l'en presserais point : bien que rentrer dans ses droits naturels et, pour ainsi dire, de bête redevenir homme, soit vraiment ce qu'il doive avoir le plus à cœur

 

». Et ça continue, les injures : «

 

misérables

 

», «

 

insensés

 

» «

 

«

 

de tant d'indignités, que les bêtes elles-mêmes ne sentiraient point ou n'endureraient pas, vous pourriez vous en délivrer, sans même tenter de le faire, mais seulement en essayant de le vouloir. Soyez donc résolus à ne plus servir et vous serez libres.

 

» Ma parole, on croirait entendre Macron jeter son mépris sur le peuple et lui dire qu'il lui suffit de traverser la rue

 

!




Mais le peuple et la jeunesse savent mieux que tous ces embourgeoisés (comme toi) et adeptes du yakafokon qui se veulent les guides (et passent vite de guides à idoles et tyrans) du peuple et de la jeunesse. S'ils t'écoutent théoriser tel l'ange faisant sans le savoir la bête, c'est d'une oreille distraite mais s'ils agissent c'est de leur profonde concentration, de leur propre sang, de leur propre force, de leur propre courage, de leur propre savoir et de leur propre pensée, instruite, elle, des réalités de ce qu'ils vivent.

À travers son empire médiatique et culturel, Bolloré mène un projet idéologique d'extrême droite.


L'attentat de Trappes en est une conséquence directe.




Pour l'arrêter, les différents fronts de lutte en résistance contre l'emprise de Bolloré sur les médias, la culture, l'édition proposent du 4 au 13 décembre prochain, 10 jours pour Zapper, Désarmer, Déborder, Débrancher Bolloré, en ciblant particulièrement la chaîne Cnews, Les magasins Relays et les Cinémas 

UGC

.




 

 

Le grand jeu




Pour démanteler l'empire Bolloré, nous avons mis en place un grand jeu 

 

! Réalisez des actions, marquez des points, faites gagner votre ville et votre région 

 

!




Jouer contre Bolloré

CNews




Détenue par le groupe Canal+ - propriété de Vincent Bolloré propage en continue des fausses informations, des idées racistes et incite à la haine.




En France le racisme n'est pas une opinion c'est un délit. 

CNEWS

 est la chaîne la plus sanctionnée par l'Arcom de l'histoire de la télévision.




Débranchons-la 

 

!




On vous propose plusieurs actions pour faire collectivement fermer CNews :




 

Organiser une soirée publique CNews = CMort chez vous.

 En faisant le tour des lieux publics : bars, kebabs etc. pour leur distribuer des certificats «

 

établissement sans CNews

 

».

Les affichettes à imprimer sont disponibles ici

 En faisant des collages massifs partout. 

Les affiches sont aussi ici

 

En rejoignant ou organisant une manifestation contre CNews le 12 décembre




Vivement le 12/12




Plus d'infos là : 




Appel à manifester contre CNews le 12/12

Les magasins Relay




Propriété de Vincent Bolloré, détiennent un monopole en gare, qui lui permettent de propager son idéologie raciste, en distribuant et en mettant en avant les livres édités par ses propres maisons d'édition, les magazines et journaux détenus par ses groupes de presse.




Imposons la fin du contrat entre les gares 

SNCF

 et Relay.




Pour organiser des actions vous pouvez 

vous inspirer des récits d'actions précédentes.




Vous pouvez également inonder les Relays 

de marque-pages anti Bolloré




Les Cinémas 

UGC




Déjà actionnaire majoritaire du groupe Canal+, en 2028 Bolloré pourrait détenir à 100% les salles 

UGC

. Bolloré contrôlerait alors toute la chaîne de production et de diffusion du Cinéma.




Il produit déjà grâce à sa société de production Studio Canal l'adaptation du livre raciste d'Eric Zemmour le Suicide Français, diffusée sur sa plateforme Mycanal.




Empêchons le rachat d'

UGC

. Boycottons Canal +.




Du 4 au 13 décembre




Collectifs, militants, associations, lieux culturels, librairie, café. Contre Cnews, Relay, 

UGC

, organisons nous.




Comment

 

?




Si vous êtes un collectif :




 les Relay : bloquer leur activité et dénoncer leur appartenance à Bolloré de diverses manières : fêtes, kiosques antiracistes devant ou à l'intérieur, collages,

stickers, marque-pages anti-Bolloré partout

, occupation des halls, tractages et fausses annonces de train...

 les 

UGC

 : banderoles, assemblées générales dans le hall, interventions de fin ou de début de séances, flyer et stickers sur les grosses sorties de décembre déguisé.es en avengers ou en fremens...

 CNews : 

aller dans un maximum de bars/kebabs/brasseries... partout où il est susceptible que CNews soit diffusé et proposer que soit affiché le certificat «

 

établissement certifié sans racisme

 

»

(ou le décerner aux établissements qui sont déjà safe 

 

!)




Des marques-pages, affiches, stickers et tracts sont trouvables en format imprimables sur le site desarmerbollore.net Ils le sont aussi probablement dans votre comité local des soulèvements de la terre. Sinon, rendez-vous aux événements publics de lancement de CMort, la campagne de mobilisation contre CNews, au cours du mois de novembre un peu partout en France 

 

!




Si vous êtes un lieu (café, cinéma, librairie etc..)




Organisez des événements en soutien au mouvement, invitez des artistes de la «

 

liste noire

 

» de Bolloré, des journalistes virés de ses rédactions, créez des espaces d'informations et de discussions et ouvrez vos portes à des collectifs pour qu'ils s'organisent.




Tous les visuels, marques-pages, affiches, modes d'emploi et les récits à venir de cette campagne d'action sont disponibles sur le site.




Informez-nous de vos actions




Pour que nous puissions communiquer sur vos actions, envoyez nous vos récits, vos photos, vos textes de revendications sur l'application Signal à @georgette.41

title: Les Bestiales #3 du 24 février au 1er mars 2027 à Bure (55)
content:
Les bestiales sont des rencontres antispécistes qui auront lieu à Bure en Meuse (55). Bure est un lieu de lutte contre un projet de méga-poubelle nucléaire.




Les bestiales sont des rencontres antispécistes. Les deux premières éditions ont eu lieu en 2023 et en 2025 à Bure. La troisième édition aura lieu du 24 février au 1

er

 mars 2027 également à Bure, plus précisément à la maison de résistance à la poubelle nucléaire, 2 rue de l'Église 55290 Bure.




Les luttes ont tendance à être vues sous des angles purement utilitariste vis à vis des êtres humain.es. alors que les grands projets de bétonisation se font au détriment des espèces qui vivent déjà dans ces environnements et contribuent à détruire les espaces de vie, de trajet, d'alimentation de tout les animaux. En projetant de sacrifier tout un territoire à la folie nucléaire sans tenir compte de tou.tes ses habitant.es – humain.es et non humain.es -, le projet de poubelle nucléaire à Bure s'inscrit complètement dans une vision spéciste. C'est pourquoi les Bestiales reviennent à Bure après les deux premières éditions en 2023 et 2025.




 

 

 

 




Nous avons l'impression qu'au milieu des urgences écologiques, antifascistes, décoloniales, etc, il est parfois dur de prendre le temps de discuter/réfléchir/agir sur des luttes tout autant centrales et entremêlées telles que l'antispécisme (et l'antinucléaire). En hiver, il fait froid, il ne se passe pas grand-chose, alors pourquoi pas se retrouver en Meuse pour se rencontrer, partager, échanger autour de l'antispécisme

 

?




Nous voyons le spécisme comme une oppression systémique qui se nourrit et qui nourrit d'autres oppressions, imbriquées les unes aux autres, aussi, nos envies pour ces rencontres est d'avoir une approche anti-autoritaire, anticapitaliste et une organisation autogestionnaire. Une attention sera portée à ne pas véhiculer d'oppressions systémiques.




Toutes les informations utiles pour venir à l'événement (infos pratiques, programmation, accessibilité) sont sur notre site bureburebure.info : 

les bestiales #3 sur bureburebure

. On peut y trouver notamment un formulaire de préinscription anonyme et facultatif accessible en suivant ce lien : 

https://forms.42l.fr/apps/forms/is4acmzMzBxb8Ett
